name: Tayke Me With You
source:
For Gene A. Ral, moving to Foccel promised fresh air, new friendships, and a chance to experience life beyond the city. But on his first day of senior year, he learns that small-town life is not as perfect as it seems. Gene befriends Kade Trembley, the school’s ambitious quarterback, but also crashes into Taylor Swann, a sharp-tongued raptor with a knack for poetry. As Gene adjusts to life in Foccel, his bond for Taylor deepens, though he is not the only one drawn to her. 

What does the town of Foccel have planned for these three? And most importantly, how will your choices affect them?

[From [url=https://atfisch.itch.io/tayke-me-with-you]itch.io[/url]]

A Snoot Game / I Wani Hug That Gator fan game.
translation:
对Gene A. Ral来说，搬到福塞尔意味着新鲜空气、新的友谊，以及体验城市之外生活的机会。然而，在高中最后一年的第一天，他发现小镇生活并不像表面看起来那样完美。吉恩与野心勃勃的校队四分卫凯德·特伦布莱成为朋友，却又与言辞尖锐、擅长诗歌的猛禽泰勒·斯旺撞个正着。随着吉恩逐渐适应福塞尔的生活，他与泰勒的感情不断加深，尽管被她吸引的并不只有他一个。

福塞尔镇究竟为这三人安排了什么？最重要的是，你的选择将如何影响他们？

[来自[url=https://atfisch.itch.io/tayke-me-with-you]itch.io[/url]]

这是《Snoot Game》和《I Wani Hug That Gator》的同人游戏。
